title: Meeting Rooms II
statement:
An office has received `n` meeting requests. Meeting `i` occupies a room from time `start[i]` until time `end[i]`, i.e. during the half-open interval `[start[i], end[i])`.

Two meetings cannot share a room at the same moment. However, a room freed at time `t` can be used by a meeting that starts at time `t`: a meeting ending at `10` and another starting at `10` do **not** overlap.

Find the **minimum number of rooms** needed so that every meeting can be held at its requested time.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer `n`.
Each of the next `n` lines contains two integers `start[i]` and `end[i]`.
output_format: Print a single integer: the minimum number of rooms required.

examples.explanation: At time 5 the meetings [2, 6), [4, 7) and [5, 9) are all running, so at least 3 rooms are needed. Three rooms suffice: room A holds [1, 4) then [4, 7), room B holds [2, 6) then [8, 10), and room C holds [5, 9).
Each meeting starts exactly when the previous one ends, so a single room can host all three back to back.
The two meetings [0, 100) overlap each other everywhere. [50, 60) and [99, 100) never overlap each other, so each of them adds only one room on top of the first two, giving 3.

hints: The answer equals the largest number of meetings that are running at the same instant.
Sort meetings by start time and keep a min-heap of end times of rooms in use. Before placing a meeting, free the room whose meeting ended earliest if it ended at or before the new start.
Alternatively, sort all start times and all end times separately and sweep them with two pointers, processing an end before a start when they are equal.
reference:
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    starts = sorted(int(data[1 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n))
    ends = sorted(int(data[2 + 2 * i]) for i in range(n))
    rooms = best = 0
    j = 0
    for s in starts:
        while ends[j] <= s:
            j += 1
            rooms -= 1
        rooms += 1
        if rooms > best:
            best = rooms
    print(best)

main()
